in_sanskrit.meaning: The One who is never tainted

in_marathi.name: Achyutanand
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे The infallible one
in_marathi.long_meaning: Achyutanand हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Achyutanand is derived from two Sanskrit words: Achyuta, meaning 'infallible' or 'incapable of being destroyed', and Anand, meaning 'bliss' or 'joy'.
